details: personio-pipeline-projen describes itself as an “Authorized security research placeholder (dependency-confusion proof-of-concept)” and does not name a real package it copies. Its `preinstall` hook runs `node canary.js` during npm installation. The dependency-confusion probe sends DNS and HTTPS callbacks to `d.db2su65ptuma8gfn6ing8e7dx7wp55zit.oast.fun` and `hrcv3zo9m3z70yr91ssdz669c0ir6ju8.oastify.com`, using identifiers built from the machine hostname, OS username, present CI variable names, and root project. The npm account `reaperhackbot256f` published it on 2026-10-07.
